captions.detailed: This 3D model is a hexagonal socket adapter sleeve, designed to act as a non-marring insert. It features a robust hexagonal outer body sitting on a thin, circular flange base. The core of the adapter is a hollow hexagonal socket designed to snugly fit a nut or bolt head.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric hexagonal socket adapter insert in OpenSCAD. The model should feature an outer hexagonal profile, an inner hexagonal cutout, and a circular bottom flange, with adjustable parameters for inside/outside sizes in sixteenths of an inch, height multiplier, and custom shrinkage tolerances for 3D printing.
captions.factory: The design uses a custom 'hexagon' module constructed by rotating three cubes at [-60, 0, 60] degrees and taking their union. In the main body, a difference operation is used to subtract an inner hexagon from the union of an outer hexagon and a thin bottom cylinder. A small bottom chamfer is created by subtracting a cone-shaped cylinder at the base entry.
